neb4a3cfa78.headline: Good year for farmers – production prices rose and fuel prices fell
neb4a3cfa78.summary: Agricultural raw material prices, including cereals, milk, and meat, rose last year, while lower oil prices reduced gasoline costs, benefiting farmers.
neb4a3cfa78.why: Input cost reductions combined with higher output prices improve farmers' profitability and influence agricultural commodity markets.
